content_hash_method: sha256 of RFC-style compact JSON produced by jq -cS over the spec object

spec.question: Does independent semantic re-derivation detect repository-defined research-trace faults more completely than manifest-only verification without rejecting clean traces?
spec.hypothesis: Across four fixed synthetic seeds and twelve fault families, the semantic grader attains at least 0.90 macro fault recall, zero clean-trace false positives, and at least 0.25 absolute recall gain over the manifest-only baseline.
spec.null_hypothesis: Any critical fault family is missed, any clean trace is rejected, or absolute macro-recall gain is below 0.25.
spec.stop_condition: All 48 corrupt cases and four clean controls are evaluated exactly once, or the adapter cannot complete and the campaign pivots to the frozen fallback.
